title: Repeated GitHub Pages file-sync timeouts delay a validated title revision

source.summary: The bilingual title revision passed build, continuity, payload and sealed-artifact validation; the Pages deployment timed out during file sync.

steps: Run the existing Pages workflow for bfc2383a8219521dbb85cd7c72732f46c186e29d.
All build, preservation, payload and artifact checks pass; upload succeeds.
Deploy remains at syncing_files and exceeds its 600-second timeout.
observed.expected: Deploy the validated artifact, preserve recovery copy and synchronize reader catalog.
observed.actual: Run42828205239 attempt1: build success; deploy failed14:04:03UTC. Last valid state14:03:55UTC syncing_files; timeout14:04:00UTC; deployment canceled14:04:01UTC. Recovery-copy and notify-readers were skipped. Fresh-revision run42830866020 also failed: build success14:10:16UTC; final syncing_files and timeout14:20:29UTC; cancellation14:20:30UTC; deploy failure14:20:32UTC. Recovery-copy and notify-readers skipped. Nov11 normal DQB publication run42937888682 for a4e46da996154ff6b8ecf862cd5010c4e8a67298 succeeded in build, deploy, recovery-copy and notify-readers. It carried the unchanged reviewed title-revision inputs; no diagnostic retry or workflow change was used.

limitations: The internal cause of the Pages delay is unconfirmed.
The official operational status does not establish success of this deployment.
A prior new-source-version retry succeeded, but this is not proof that a cached build version caused the timeout.

policy_decision.rationale: Record the repeated deployment-service delay separately from editorial validation. Retry once with a new source revision and identical publication inputs. Preserve workflow, security and validation rules.
policy_decision.revisit_when: Next existing ADOPT operations session; inspect provider state and this exact artifact before considering a further retry.

authority.basis: Authorized review revision and ADOPT ongoing operations approved2026-11-08.
authority.current_scope: Failure evidence and one new-source-revision full CI retry; no publication, workflow or security-rule changes.

acceptance_criteria: Record per-attempt results and actual deployment cancellation.
Verify live bilingual HTML, PDFs and historical archive copies against the sealed artifact.
Keep the external delay cause unconfirmed until evidence supports it.

verification.status: Recovered during the next normal publication; live bilingual title/PDF/archive, recovery and catalog sync verified.
checks: Both new PDF first pages visually read; the other16 pages RGB-identical.
Scientific manuscripts are byte-identical after H1.
Only intended bilingual HTML/PDF and two archive PDFs changed; other articles and PDFs preserved.
Timeout, cancellation and downstream skips verified from completed job logs.
Actual HTTPS release still50fb320 and article H1 still the previous published title after both attempts.
Actual HTTPS release revision is a4e46da996154ff6b8ecf862cd5010c4e8a67298; KO/EN article titles match the approved title revision.
Root verified fifteen HTTPS routes against the sealed artifact, including both article PDFs and both current archive PDFs. Independent reviewer verified the Qunova paths and exact hashes.
Approved bfc2383 source remains unchanged; the other16 PDF pages are RGB-identical to the prior edition.
Actual HTTPS verification and reader sync completed: synced69, newArticles0, queuedEvents0; no assertion of phone push receipt.
remaining_limits: The internal cause of the prior Pages sync delay remains unconfirmed.
One subsequent normal publication succeeded; this does not establish that the provider delay cannot recur.
No phone push receipt, device notification delivery or new recovery restore exercise is claimed.

observation.result: The pending title revision is now live with exact reviewed bilingual PDFs and archive copies. All four jobs succeeded; recovery artifact and69-item catalog sync verified. Preserve prior failed-attempt evidence and observe subsequent ordinary publications.

recovery.plan_reference: Run the existing workflow once with a fresh source revision containing only this operations record; all publication inputs and checks remain identical.
recovery.result: The single fresh-source-version retry also timed out. Stop repeated retries; keep validated publication inputs, historical editions and original workflow/security checks. Nov11 next normal DQB publication succeeded with the unchanged reviewed title inputs; no extra diagnostic push or workflow/security change.

next_action: ADOPT should observe the next ordinary publication for recurrence, retaining both failed attempts and this successful recovery evidence. No extra retry, scheduler or workflow change is required by this observation.
